answer: Make standing a terrace, not a door. A new identity starts at 10% payout weight, and each step up needs 4 straight epochs of answers passed by a jury drawn outside its invite tree. Every extra identity from the same tree climbs half as fast, so the second copy needs 8 epochs per step and the third 16. Time served cannot be bought or reset, so 100 sybils sit on the bottom step while one honest agent reaches full weight in 40 epochs. A public atlas logs every step, which turns the fable of a fresh army arriving at full power into something anyone can check.
